prompt.text:
Implement a framework-free single-choice model as one complete TypeScript source file.

Export:
- `interface ChoiceSpec { readonly value: string; readonly caption: string; readonly idleGlyph?: string; readonly activeGlyph?: string; readonly color?: string; readonly disabled?: boolean }`
- `interface ChoiceView extends ChoiceSpec { readonly selected: boolean }`
- `class ChoiceModel`

Constructor: `constructor(groupKey: string, choices: readonly ChoiceSpec[], initialValue?: string, direction?: "ltr" | "rtl")`.

The trimmed group key must be nonempty. Every choice value and caption must be nonempty after trimming, and normalized values must be unique. Invalid input or a malformed direction must throw `RangeError`. Store normalized copies, never caller objects. An initial value is selected only if its trimmed value identifies an enabled choice; otherwise nothing is selected. An empty choices array is valid.

Expose readonly `groupKey` and `direction`, plus:
- `select(value: string): boolean`: select the matching enabled choice and return true. Blank, unknown, or disabled values return false without clearing the current selection.
- `selectedValue(): string | undefined`
- `view(): ChoiceView[]`: preserve input order and return fresh objects on every call.

Only one choice may be selected, and caller mutations of constructor input or returned arrays must not affect the model.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
